name: cmdb_sync_data_audit
label: Configuration Management -- sync_data_audit Table
description: Configure the sync_data_audit table, which belongs to the configuration management module. It can be used for related queries and report queries in configuration management scenarios.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: audit_id
fields.description: Audit ID, each audit ID is recorded once and only once. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: collection_name
fields.description: Collection name. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: data_id
fields.description: The unique identifier for MongoDB data. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_audit_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the audit_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_collection
indexes.description: Standard index covering the collection_name field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: uk
indexes.description: Unique index covering the data_id, ci_collection_id fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
